outcome: Diagnosis of Type 2 Congenital pulmonary airway malformation (CPAM)
cohort: A neonatal boy with a left-sided congenital diaphragmatic hernia diagnosed after birth.
finding: Type 2 CPAM was incidentally diagnosed after thoracoscopic repair of a left-sided CDH in a neonatal boy, suggesting that concurrent congenital lung lesions should be considered in CDH patients.
